text:
jessica: Quick ping — opened a tiny PR to add an audit column for credential provisioning events. Need a couple of eyes before I merge, it's blocking the compliance rollout this week. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4281 :pray:

omar: Looking now, thanks for the ping. main concern is the DB migration ordering — does this require a deploy window?

jessica: Good question. It's a non-blocking nullable column and we only write to it from the new service. Migration is online-safe but wanted to verify schema + RBAC changes.

sylvia: @jessica can you paste the migration snippet? also, did you update the audit log parsing in the analytics job?

jessica: Sure — snippet below:
```sql
ALTER TABLE credential_events ADD COLUMN provisioning_context jsonb NULL;
CREATE INDEX ON credential_events ((provisioning_context->>'caller'));
```
I added a small decoder in analytics to include provisioning_context when present, but it falls back safely.

kevin: Quick read. Two tiny nits: 1) index expression should be hashed for lookup patterns if we search by caller equality a lot, 2) add a feature flag around writing the new field for 2 deploy cycles.

jessica: Good catches. I'll switch to `CREATE INDEX ON credential_events ((provisioning_context->>'caller')) USING HASH;` and add the feature flag.

omar: Security note — make sure we don't write PII into provisioning_context. If any caller identifiers are sensitive, redact before storing. Add unit tests for that.

jessica: Yep — added a sanitizer function and tests in the PR.

sylvia: I can give a formal approval once feature flag is added. :+1:

kevin: LGTM after the index change and feature flag.

security-bot: Automated check: migration size small (<1s for 1000 rows), no schema conflicts detected. CI: ✅

jessica: Thanks all — will update PR now and ping when ready for merge. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :rocket:
